basics.name: Mikayel Aramyan
basics.label: Ph.D. Student in Mechanical Engineering
basics.summary: I work at the intersection of multi-agent optimization, control theory, robotics, and machine learning for safety-critical autonomy. My focus is on scalable consensus algorithms with formal guarantees, ensuring heterogeneous UAVs (Unmanned Aerial Vehicles, drones), remain robust under communication loss, uncertainty, and disturbance. By uniting rigorous theory with real-world experiments, my research advances autonomy for applications like package delivery, wildfire suppression, and aerial surveillance.

work.name: Apple
work.summary: Developed scalable, high-fidelity models for predicting temperature in System-on-Chip (SoC) architectures, which integrate multiple computing components such as CPU, GPU, and memory onto a single chip. Combined both physics-based and data-driven machine learning methods, with validation in closed-loop settings to ensure accuracy and robustness under realistic operating conditions.
highlights: Designed and benchmarked gray-box thermal models, linear/nonlinear ARX models, and AI methods such as deep neural networks (DNNs) and physics-informed neural networks (PINNs)
Developed an end-to-end pipeline for collecting training datasets, preprocessing, model training, validation, and deployment of closed-loop simulations (Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch)
Achieved reliable SoC temperature prediction with lumped-element thermal models, reaching ~80% out-of-sample (OOS) accuracy and reducing error by 15–20% compared to baselines

work.name: Aerial Robotics Laboratory (NPUA)
work.summary: Developed and integrated flight control software for autonomous drones using C++, MATLAB/Simulink to implement and evaluate control system algorithms.
highlights: Developed and integrated flight control software for autonomous drones using C++, MATLAB/Simulink to implement and evaluate control system algorithms (PID, Geometric, L1 Adaptive)
Utilized software-in-the-loop (SIL) simulation to debug, fine-tune, and validate controller performance prior to real-world flight tests
Conducted real-world flight experiments to assess robustness and adaptability under challenging conditions, including added payloads and wind disturbances

projects.name: Autonomous Vehicle Summoning (Course Project)
projects.summary: Developed a full-stack autonomous vehicle summoning system featuring path generation, obstacle detection, self-parking and a mobile user interface, fully integrated into the ROS-based GEMstack software stack and conduct in-vehicle tests on GEMe2.
highlights: Implemented motion planning for collision-free path generation using RRT* and Reeds–Shepp curves for autonomous parking and summoning maneuvers
Integrated real-time obstacle detection using YOLO-based perception pipeline for enhanced safety and situational awareness, utilizing onboard cameras and LiDAR
Developed a mobile application enabling users to specify pick-up and drop-off locations, interfacing with the autonomous vehicle system (GEMstack)

projects.name: Autonomous UV Disinfection Robot (Startup Project)
projects.summary: Led a team of engineers in developing an autonomous UV sterilization robot designed to disinfect environments such as hospitals, schools and offices. Won 1st place award for 'UVON Desk' project at Fab Lab Armenia.
highlights: Integrated LiDAR-based SLAM algorithm for autonomous navigation on an onboard NVIDIA Jetson Xavier NX computer
Tested and validated the UV system's effectiveness through controlled laboratory experiments on E. coli bacteria, demonstrating reliable disinfection performance
Conducted research on germicidal properties of UVC light emitted from HID Mercury Vapor lamps with bacteriological analysis

projects.name: Fab Academy (Program Projects)
projects.summary: Six month global program by MIT's Center for Bits and Atoms focused on digital fabrication, rapid prototyping, and hands-on engineering. Learned to design, prototype, and fabricate smart devices integrating mechanical, electronic, and software components by completing weekly projects.
highlights: Gained experience in PCB design, microcontroller programming using C/C++, 3D modeling and printing, laser cutting and embedded system design in weekly projects
Learned digital fabrication tools including Fusion 360, SolidWorks, Eagle, KiCad, Arduino, Python, and embedded C
